title: DCRLR/3/2007 of KAMLESHWAR PRASAD Vs STATE AND OTHERS

paras.text:
DCRLR No.03/07
Honíble Dharam Veer J.
(Delay Condonation App. No.Nil/2007)
Sri S.C. Tyagi, learned counsel for the revisionist and Sri Tanuj
Semwal, learned AGA for the State as well as Sri R.P. Nautiyal,
learned counsel for respondent nos.2 & 3, are present.
 I have perused the application moved by learned counsel for the
revisionist. There is delay of 276 days in filing the revision. The
grounds shown in the affidavit filed along with the delay condonation
application are sufficient to condone the delay. The delay in filling the
revision has been explained by sufficient cause.
 The delay condonation application is allowed. Delay is hereby
condoned.
 I have also heard learned counsel for the revisionist and learned
counsel for respondent nos.2 & 3 and perused the judgment and
order dated 8.03.2006 passed by Additional Family Court, Roorkee in
Case No.148/2004, Smt. Deepa Devi & another Vs. Kamleshwar
Prasad.
 Admit.
 Learned counsel for both the parties have submitted that there
are chances of reconciliation between the parties. Hence, the case is
fixed on 21st June 2008 before the Lok Adalat.
 Revisionist-Kamleshwar Prasad and respondent no.2-Smt.
Deepa Devi are directed to appear in person before the Lok Adalat on
21st June 2008.
